description: This file contains conversion functions and type definitions for media and OMX components within the Android hardware media stack, specifically for the OMX 1.0 implementation. It includes functions for wrapping, converting, and handling various media-related data structures and enums, facilitating interoperability between different representations and ensuring proper resource management.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Enumeration representing various status codes used in media and OMX operations.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Structure representing messages exchanged in OMX communication, including event, buffer, and render data.

classes.name: OMXFenceParcelable
classes.description: Class encapsulating a fence file descriptor for synchronization.

classes.name: ColorAspects
classes.description: Structure representing color aspects for media processing.

classes.name: CodecBuffer
classes.description: Structure representing a media buffer with various types and attributes.

methods.name: toStatus
methods.description: Converts a status_t value to a Status object.

methods.name: wrapAs (omx_message, Message)
methods.description: Wraps an omx_message into a Message object, creating native handles as needed.

methods.name: wrapAs (Message, omx_message)
methods.description: Wraps a Message object into an omx_message, reading file descriptors from handles.

methods.name: convertTo (omx_message, Message)
methods.description: Converts a Message into an omx_message, duplicating file descriptors for extended lifetime.

methods.name: wrapAs (OMXFenceParcelable, hidl_handle)
methods.description: Wraps OMXFenceParcelable into a hidl_handle, creating native handles.

methods.name: wrapAs (hidl_handle, OMXFenceParcelable)
methods.description: Wraps a hidl_handle into OMXFenceParcelable by reading the file descriptor.

methods.name: convertTo (OMXFenceParcelable, hidl_handle)
methods.description: Converts a hidl_handle to OMXFenceParcelable, duplicating file descriptors.

methods.name: toCompactColorAspects
methods.description: Converts media::ColorAspects to a compact int32_t representation.

methods.name: wrapAs (CodecBuffer, sp<GraphicBuffer>)
methods.description: Wraps a GraphicBuffer into a CodecBuffer.

methods.name: wrapAs (CodecBuffer, OMXBuffer)
methods.description: Wraps an OMXBuffer into a CodecBuffer.

methods.name: convertTo (OMXBuffer, CodecBuffer)
methods.description: Converts a CodecBuffer into an OMXBuffer.
